name: Sequential-NIAH
intro: Sequential-NIAH是一个专门用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）从长上下文中提取有序信息项（即“针”）能力的基准测试。该基准测试包含三种“针”的生成方式，上下文长度从8K到128K不等，共计14000个样本。为了评估模型表现，研究者训练了一个评估模型，通过比较答案的完整性和顺序一致性来打分，提供了比GPT-4或Claude更可靠的评估指标。
org: Zhejiang University, Ant Group, Tencent Youtu Lab, Beihang University, Cornell University
build_method: 三条生成流水线, GPT-4o改写, 长文本一一配对与随机插针, 专用评估器微调
metric: Evaluator Accuracy, Completeness and Order Correctness
build_method_en: Three generation pipelines, GPT-4o rewriting, one-to-one long-context pairing with random insertion, and evaluator fine-tuning
eval_feature_en: Long context, bilingual data, ordered multi-needle retrieval, and a validated task-specific evaluator
intro_en: Sequential-NIAH evaluates ordered multi-needle extraction from 8K-to-128K contexts. Its 14,000 bilingual samples use synthetic-temporal, real-temporal, and real-logical pipelines, and a fine-tuned evaluator checks answer completeness and order.
metric_en: Evaluator Accuracy, Completeness and Order Correctness

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Sequential-NIAH arXiv:2504.04713 Sections 2-4 and Appendices; official miraclefish/Sequential-NIAH-Benchmark repository. Sequential-NIAH creates 14,000 long-context samples with three pipelines. Synthetic-temporal data combines fake subjects, times, and events into sequences of 3 to 15 needles. Real-temporal data draws from ICEWS and FEG temporal knowledge graphs and uses GPT-4o to rewrite chains of 3 to 10 events. Real-logical data filters 2,986 private open-domain QA examples, manually checks samples, and rewrites them into natural sequential needles. The resulting 6,000 synthetic-temporal, 5,014 real-temporal, and 2,986 real-logical QA items are paired one-to-one with 8K to 128K texts sampled from LongData-Corpus, shuffled, and inserted at random positions. The bilingual set contains 7,500 English and 6,500 Chinese examples and is split 10,000 train, 2,000 development, and 2,000 test. A Qwen2.5-32B evaluator is fine-tuned on shuffled, missing, redundant, and incorrect answer variants with GPT-4o rationales and reaches 99.49 percent validation accuracy. Target models run on the 2,000 test items; the evaluator judges completeness and order, and accuracy is reported by context length, needle count, and pipeline.
